operator_assessment.operator_summary: The regenerated presentation export matches the last published canonical revision tournament-for-tournament (183 unchanged, zero added/removed/changed). Publication scope is ELIGIBLE with no held or blocking tournaments. Season-wide planning debt (participation shortfalls, 9 unplaced U10 placements, hosting imbalances, external-calendar conflicts) is unchanged from the published baseline and is not introduced by the presentation change.

key_tradeoffs.title: Presentation change only
key_tradeoffs.summary: Adds an upcoming-only filter (default on), past-week fading and a today marker to the club heatmap. Tournament data is identical to the published page.

remaining_actions.title: Season-wide planning debt
remaining_actions.summary: Participation shortfalls, the 9 unplaced U10 placements and host-calendar conflicts remain canonical maintenance work and are not part of this publication delta.

limitations: Semantic review used the bounded audit overview and the category evidence listed above, not every individual record.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: 128 participation shortfalls, 264 target deviations and 137 manual participation placements remain unresolved season-wide. Identical to the last published revision (published-to-canonical delta is zero), so this is pre-existing planning debt, not introduced by this export.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: 9 unresolved tournament placements (for example U10 2026-12-26, hosted by Jar, rejected candidates all on host external calendar conflicts or team already playing), 16 hosting-balance imbalances, 5 same-age hosting repairs. Hosting responsibility did not change versus the published baseline.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: 169 duration records checked; no blocking byes; 5 input-constrained shapes and 5 guest reservations are recorded and understood.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: 10 manually placed tournaments conflict with external host calendars (for example rvv-0095, rvv-0121, rvv-0155, all Frisk Asker), 46 underfilled tournaments, and 10 placements are unverified for Frisk Asker and Sandefjord Penguins. These placements publish as proposed awaiting host confirmation, not as booked.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: 14 same-club participant cases; 0 above the hard maximum of 3.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: All export checks match the plan: 2331 CSV game rows, 183 overview rows, 142 team-count rows, 183 iCal events, 183 XLSX tournament rows. Artifact parity PASS.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verification OK with 0 violations, 0 waivers and 0 stale approvals. Observed tooling issue: audit-context workflow block still points at export 2026-10-16T0715 (phase audit_required) while the bound export fingerprint and output files are 2026-10-16T0929. Verdict bound to the 0929 fingerprint.

potential_missing_rule.description: audit-context workflow block can reference an older export directory than the bound export_fingerprint/output_files (0715 vs 0929). Worth checking whether workflow.export_dir should follow the current export.
